summary: Iteration 2 testing for FinFlow (PDF export, dashboard date-range filters, quick-entry page, new default categories). Backend: 24/24 pytest cases passed (17 baseline + 7 new). Frontend: Playwright E2E verified date-range presets (This month, Last 30, Last 90, YTD, Custom) update summary stats and labels; Quick-entry mode toggle switches expense<->income chips, keypad accumulates and renders amount, picking 'Other' surfaces the Specify input, save creates a transaction (count incremented 1->2) and resets the form; Invoices 'Download PDF' button triggered an actual PDF download (suggested_filename=INV-PLAY-1852.pdf). All 7 new default expense categories (Rent, Fuel Exp, Toll, Cab Exp, Train/Bus Booking, Food, Other) verified present for admin and a freshly-registered user. Idempotency verified: no duplicate default categories after the backfill migration ran on startup.

minor.issue: When start is omitted but end is provided, period_start defaults to first-of-this-month and end is used as-is, but period_end is returned as the raw `end` param (no validation that end >= start). Likely fine but worth a guard.
Same as above — no start/end ordering validation; bad inputs silently return empty list.

issues: Custom date inputs use the browser-native <input type=date> picker (already true app-wide). Not a shadcn Calendar — acceptable but inconsistent with shadcn aesthetic.
TEST_PlayCat from previous iteration's seed still shows up as an expense chip (test residue from iteration_1). Not a bug — just leftover seed data.

action_items: (Optional) Validate start<=end on /api/dashboard/summary and /api/dashboard/expense-by-category and return 400 on invalid ranges.
(Optional / leftover) Clean up TEST_PlayCat / TEST_PlayClient seed artifacts from previous iteration in admin user's data.
critical_code_review_comments: Startup backfill loop iterates all users and runs a find + insert per user — fine for small N, but could be a single aggregation/bulk write for scale.

Default expense category 'Other' is hardcoded; QuickEntry detects it via name.startsWith('other') (case-insensitive) — fragile if a user renames or deletes that category (Specify input will silently never appear). Consider a stable flag/icon key on the category record.
QuickEntry sends category_id as null when none picked; backend stores null. List_transactions does not validate category_id ownership — same FK gap flagged in iteration_1.
downloadInvoicePDF (jsPDF) generates client-side; no server-side PDF endpoint. Acceptable for MVP but inconsistent for headless email or scheduled sends.
server.py still ~735 lines — split recommendation from iteration_1 still open.
seed_data_creation: test_iteration2 tests create a transient registered user (test_iter2_*@example.com) and a couple of admin transactions on 2031-06-15 / 2031-08-15 which are deleted in tearDown. Playwright run created 1 TEST_iter2 expense (25.00, Food) on admin which is NOT auto-cleaned. Previous iteration_1 TEST_PlayCat/TEST_PlayClient artifacts still present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest files now form the regression baseline: test_finflow_api.py (17 tests) + test_iteration2.py (7 tests). Run both: `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Frontend: QuickEntry uses category.name.toLowerCase().startsWith('other') to detect the Other chip — if you add a new 'Other XYZ' category it will also trigger the Specify input. PDF download is fully client-side (jsPDF). To verify PDF in Playwright use `async with page.expect_download(): await btn.click()` — confirmed working in headless. Dashboard `range` state is a useMemo; changing the preset Select triggers a refetch via useEffect dependency.
rca of the issue: No bugs. All iteration 2 features behave as specified.
